**Business Domain:**
Military Vehicle Specifications and Analytics

**Business Scenario:**
A defense organization is developing an enterprise-level Military Vehicle Management and Analytics System. This system is designed to catalog, monitor, and analyze various specifications and performance metrics of military vehicles. The platform must accommodate data related to dimensions, weight, and operational capacities of different vehicle types, such as armored personnel carriers, tanks, and support vehicles.

The system should support detailed specifications for each vehicle model, including dimensions like length, width, height, ground clearance, and weight. Additionally, the platform should incorporate real-time analytics to assess vehicle performance under different conditions and usage scenarios. The data will be used to guide maintenance schedules, optimize vehicle deployment, and inform procurement decisions.

The system should also enable users to compare different models based on their specifications and performance metrics, facilitating strategic decisions regarding vehicle upgrades and replacements. User roles for vehicle operators, maintenance personnel, analysts, and administrators should be defined to manage access and editing rights effectively.

Furthermore, the system should integrate with logistics and operations modules, providing comprehensive insights into vehicle inventory, readiness, and deployment across various military units and geographic locations.
